abstract: The aim of the present study was to investigate the expression of nm23-H1 in human placenta, hydatidiform mole and choriocarcinoma cells. Nm23-H1 protein was localized in the cytotrophoblast, but not in the syncytiotrophoblast. In the hydatidiform mole cases with subsequent spontaneous remission, nm23-H1 mRNA levels were significantly lower than those in first-trimester placentas. However, its levels were elevated in the hydatidiform mole cases that progressed to persistent gestational trophoblastic disease and were comparable to those of first-trimester placentas, and they were further elevated in choriocarcinoma cells. The present data suggest an association of nm23-H1 for the proliferation activity of trophoblast, and its increased expression may influence the development of persistent trophoblastic disease.
abstract_ja: 本研究の目的は、ヒト胎盤、胞状奇胎、絨毛癌細胞におけるnm23-H1の発現を調べることであった。nm23-H1タンパク質は細胞性栄養膜細胞に局在し、合胞体栄養膜細胞には認められなかった。自然寛解した胞状奇胎症例では、nm23-H1 mRNAのレベルは妊娠初期の胎盤と比べて有意に低かった。一方、持続性妊娠性絨毛性疾患に進展した胞状奇胎症例ではそのレベルが上昇し、妊娠初期の胎盤と同程度であり、絨毛癌細胞ではさらに上昇していた。本データは、nm23-H1が栄養膜細胞の増殖活性と関連していることを示唆しており、その発現増加が持続性栄養膜疾患の発症に影響しうることを示している。
